regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and full two-column introduction

The abstract is an article-level summary, while radical vinyl-acetate/allyl-alcohol routes and earlier Ti/Ni/rare-earth allene polymerizations are cited prior context and were not promoted to current-paper experiments.

regions.finding: Inspected all seven monomer drawings. A and B are explicitly named n-decylallene and n-hexylallene; C-G remain source-labeled where safe complete encodings were uncertain. Scheme 1 is a monomer inventory, not seven reaction experiments.
Inspected catalyst structures and mapped labels 1a/1b/2a/2b/3 to the Table 1 and Table 2 experiments. Scheme 2 is a catalyst inventory, not a preparation procedure.

Mapped narrative conversion/selectivity and NMR assignments to the corresponding Table 1/Table 2 and post-functionalization records; Figure 1 is characterization, not additional polymerization runs.
